scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, tagline, brief description, and primary/secondary CTAs correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL in a browser
steps.context: Fresh page load with cleared cache

steps.description: Check that 'MirDB' product name is prominently displayed in the hero section
Confirm tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is visible
Check primary CTA (Get Started/View on GitHub) and secondary CTA (Documentation) are present and functional

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is visible and prominently styled
Tagline text matches 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol'

test_cases.input: Inspect hero section for brief description
test_cases.expected: 1-2 sentence description explaining MirDB's purpose is present
User is navigated to Get Started section or GitHub repository
User is navigated to documentation link

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the features section showcases key MirDB features with proper descriptions

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features section of the homepage
Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed with proper content
Confirm each feature card contains accurate technical information

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for Memcached compatibility card
test_cases.expected: Feature card explaining Memcached Protocol Compatibility is present with description

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for persistence card
test_cases.expected: Feature card explaining Persistent Storage with SSTables is present

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for LSM architecture card
test_cases.expected: Feature card explaining LSM Tree Architecture is present

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for async networking card
test_cases.expected: Feature card explaining Async Networking with Tokio is present
Features section contains 3-4 feature cards

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the quick start section

test_cases.input: Inspect quick start section for installation command
test_cases.expected: Installation command using cargo or build instructions is visible with syntax highlighting

test_cases.expected: TOML configuration example showing addr, work_dir, and other parameters is displayed

test_cases.input: Inspect quick start section for usage example

scenarios.name: Performance - Page Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify homepage loads within the required 2-second threshold

steps.description: Load homepage and measure time to first contentful paint and complete load
Execute Lighthouse performance audit on the homepage
Verify LCP, FID, and CLS metrics are within acceptable ranges

test_cases.input: Measure page load time on simulated broadband
test_cases.expected: Page fully loads within 2 seconds
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher
LCP occurs within 2.5 seconds
CLS score is less than 0.1
Critical CSS is inlined, non-critical resources are deferred
